entries.title: Cloudroom v164 (macOS Apple Silicon, Linux x64, Windows x64)
entries.note: Cloudroom v164 Share only the repos you pick. For Apple Silicon Macs on macOS 13 or later, Linux x64, and Windows x64. Changes Connect GitHub can now share only the repos you pick with cloud agents. Hitting a Claude plan limit in a Cloud thread shows the plan-limit card, not a raw error. Cloud previews of dev servers load right away instead of stalling. Image attachments show small thumbnails in the message box, and privacy mode hides your email. Security fixes. Install or update macOS: Quit Cloudroom, download the DMG, open it, and drag Cloudroom into Applications. Your data is kept. Signed and notarized by Apple. Linux x64: For Ubuntu 24.04+ and current Arch Linux. chmod +x Cloudroom-v164-x86_64.AppImage ./Cloudroom-v164-x86_64.AppImage If it does not open, add --no-sandbox . For a FUSE error, install libfuse2t64 (Ubuntu) or fuse2 (Arch). Windows x64: For Windows 11. Needs Git for Wind

entries.title: Core 0.1.121
entries.note: A second Claude plan limit right after the first one is now caught in Cloud threads, so you see the plan-limit card instead of a raw error. Temporary rate limits and "high load" errors are no longer mistaken for plan limits. Cloud previews of dev servers load at full speed instead of stalling for half a minute. Cloud agents recognize the room-cli installed by the machine installer. Linux builds of Cloudroom core at a598fcfe833f , tested by CI. VMs verify them by SHA-256. Want hosted Cloudroom instead? Get started .

entries.title: Core 0.1.120
entries.note: Core updates now wait while a large thread history loads, instead of rolling back. Cloud loops refuse a wrong project or target flag instead of silently ignoring it. Cloud agents are told to read an AGENTS.md file that lands after their session starts. A parent thread now says when its child was moved to the top level. OpenCode child threads start correctly after a sandbox wakes up. Linux builds of Cloudroom core at d0775b0948da , tested by CI. VMs verify them by SHA-256. Want hosted Cloudroom instead? Get started .

entries.title: Cloudroom v162 (macOS Apple Silicon, Linux x64, Windows x64)
entries.note: Cloudroom v162 GitLab projects in the cloud. For Apple Silicon Macs on macOS 13 or later, Linux x64, and Windows x64. Changes Cloud threads now work with GitLab.com projects, not just GitHub. Unused worktrees park themselves to free disk, and threads keep running after a worktree move. The app starts faster, and sleeping threads open their history at once. A subagent bar under the thread title shows every child thread at a glance. Signed-out accounts show a one-click Sign in again button right in the chat. Security fixes. Install or update macOS: Quit Cloudroom, download the DMG, open it, and drag Cloudroom into Applications. entries.title: Cloudroom v161 (macOS Apple Silicon, Linux x64, Windows x64)
entries.note: Cloudroom v161 The Antigravity Update. For Apple Silicon Macs on macOS 13 or later, Linux x64, and Windows x64. Changes Antigravity is a full agent now: one-click Google sign-in, High thinking by default, and it shows even before you install it. Antigravity runs in Cloud threads too, and its plan and quota show in the usage box and Settings. Fork and Move to worktree work for every agent, not just Claude Code and Codex. Long voice recordings are never lost, on your phone or your computer. Computer use no longer steals focus from the chat input while you type. Archiving a Cloud thread is instant, and Undo works in split panes. Cursor's context meter shows real usage, and large local images open in previews. Security fixes. entries.title: Core 0.1.119
entries.note: Cloud threads work with GitLab.com projects. Cloud threads can pin themselves, their children, and threads they start. A subagent reply in flight no longer brings back a child that is being archived. Large accounts load fully, with no cut-off at 1,000 rows. Linux builds of Cloudroom core at b3642edf4768 , tested by CI. VMs verify them by SHA-256. Want hosted Cloudroom instead? Get started .

entries.title: Core 0.1.118

entries.title: Cloudroom v159 (macOS Apple Silicon, Linux x64, Windows x64)
entries.note: Cloudroom v159 A new Ultra Fast speed. For Apple Silicon Macs on macOS 13 or later, Linux x64, and Windows x64. Changes Codex has a third speed: pick Standard, Fast, or Ultra Fast in the model picker, or type /ultrafast. With the sidebar open, the chat is now centered in the free space. A short connection drop to a remote computer no longer interrupts threads still running on it. A Codex thread stuck on "already has an active writer" recovers on your next message. On Windows, Claude skills load without admin rights, and Cursor sign-in works when its CLI is off PATH. Security fixes. Install or update macOS: Quit Cloudroom, download the DMG, open it, and drag Cloudroom into Applications. Your data is kept. Signed and notarized by Apple.
